definitions.supplemental: Icel. sigðr ; m. : sigd (in Norway) a sickle.

quotations.old_english: Befeóll án síþe of ðam snǽde intó ánum deópan seáþe

source_text: síþe (from sigþe), es ; m. A scythe, implement for mowing :--Sigdi, síþe falcis, Txts. 62, 430. Síþe, Wrt. Voc. ii. 35, 1 : falx, 38, 51 : i. 34, 64 : falcastrum, 16, 16 : 85, 3 : ii. 33, 74. Befeóll án síþe of ðam snǽde intó ánum deópan seáþe, Homl. Th. ii. 162, 10. Hé sceal habban . . . síþe, Anglia ix. 263, 5. [Icel. sigðr ; m. : sigd (in Norway) a sickle.]
